DML.SELECT: SELECT scenario_id as "id", alias as "alias", description as "description", n_rows as "nRows", n_columns as "nColumns", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM conf.cctv_scenarios WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.cctv_scenarios (scenario_id, alias, description, n_rows, n_columns, enabled, visible) VALUES (:id=getNextId{'conf.cctv_scenarios'$'scenario_id'} , :alias , :description , :nRows , :nColumns , :enabled , :visible)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE conf.cctv_scenarios SET alias = :alias, description = :description, n_rows = :nRows, n_columns = :nColumns, enabled = :enabled, visible = :visible WHERE scenario_id = :id
